detail.title: Investigating Theoretical Frameworks of Consciousness
detail.summary: This cycle focuses on the enforced research topic of consciousness, specifically initiating work on the comparative analysis of major scientific theories. The primary goal is to examine how empirical observations ground Integrated Information Theory (IIT) and Global Neuronal Workspace Theory (GNWT), highlighting their conceptual and predictive divergences.

children.title: Integrated Information Theory vs Global Neuronal Workspace Theory empirical comparison review

detail.reason: To fulfill the project's next step by identifying comparative reviews of these two leading theories.
